description: When a teammate changes a vein status first, the notice under the select reads "This field changed since it was read; refresh its context" and "Your draft is preserved. Review the latest context before making a new edit." A select has no draft, and it already shows the new value, so nothing needs refreshing. The notice does not say who changed it or to what, and the user's choice (Proven) is silently dropped.
expected: "Setup agent changed this to Abandoned while you were choosing Proven. Choose again if you still want Proven."
actual: Draft and refresh copy under a select that already shows Abandoned.
suggested_fix: Use select-specific STALE copy naming the new value and author, and offer a one-click re-apply.

description: A network failure on a vein status change shows the raw browser string "Failed to fetch" as the notice title.
expected: Plain copy such as "Couldn't reach your Pardner service. Your change is saved for retry."
actual: "Failed to fetch / Your last confirmed data remains available. [Retry saved request]"
suggested_fix: Map fetch TypeErrors to a human message.

criterion: Error states visible before user acts
description: While a status change is merely in flight (not failed), a page-wide banner already says "A request is awaiting confirmation." with a Retry saved request button. Every goal and vein select and New task are disabled.
expected: A quiet saving indicator for a slow request; Retry appears only after a failure.
actual: A recovery banner and Retry button during normal latency.
suggested_fix: Delay the banner until the request fails or exceeds a timeout.

criterion: Navigation: user always knows where they are
description: Marking a goal Achieved moves the whole goal block from the top to the bottom of the list. Achieved goals look identical to open ones apart from the select value: no dimming, no group heading.
expected: Achieved and abandoned goals are visibly grouped or de-emphasised so the jump is explained.
actual: The goal jumps from first to last with no visual cue.
suggested_fix: Add a "Closed goals" subheading or muted styling for achieved and abandoned goals.
